title: Release Manager IT (f/m/d)
description:
Coordinate releases across ten delivery teams for our banking platform.

What you'll do
- Plan release trains and maintain the release calendar
- Chair go/no-go meetings with engineering, QA and operations
- Track defects and risks with Jira dashboards

What you bring
- 3+ years in release or project coordination in IT
- Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and ITIL change management
- Good communication in English
